name: Ikaruga (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ikaruga town emblem in red: an outlined stylised bird with outstretched wings bearing the character 斑.
history: Municipal flag of Ikaruga, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in February 1947.

features.role: Ikaruga town emblem — an outlined stylised bird with outstretched wings bearing the character 斑
